_comment: kinoheld IDs discovered 2026-07-07 via the cinemas(search:) GraphQL query (API capture in scraper/debug/woki_curl.txt); every ID verified against programByMovie. 'website' is the cinema's own site — showtime links point there instead of kinoheld; non-kinoheld ticket deeplinks (CineStar, kinotickets.express, chain shops) are kept. Cinemas with 'source': 'custom' have their scraper in sources/custom.py.

cinemas.name: Kinopolis Bad Godesberg
cinemas._note: Moltkestr. 7 = Bad Godesberg. Scraped from their own CineOrder ticket shop (sources/kinopolis.py), which cineorder_center_oid unlocks: kinoheld was missing newly announced films and filed a few screenings under the wrong film (checked 2026-07-25). The shop also carries the OV/OmU version per screening and the exact prices (sources/cineorder.py) in the same one request. kinoheld_id 837 ('Kinopolis Bonn' there) is kept as the fallback if that shop call ever fails.

cinemas.name: Bonner Kinemathek

ticket_note.de: Karten verkauft die Kinemathek über ihre eigene Seite. Wo wir die Vorstellung dort wiederfinden, führt der Link direkt zum Ticketkauf — sonst zum Programm.
ticket_note.en: The Kinemathek sells tickets on its own site. Where we can find the screening there the link goes straight to the checkout, otherwise to the programme.

cinemas._note: listed as 'Bonner Kinemathek - Kino in der Brotfabrik' on kinoheld. kinoheld carries the programme but sells nothing for them (Cinepass back-end: no per-show route, deeplink is just their homepage), so booking links are joined on from their own event pages, which carry the cinetixx Tickets button — see own_ticket_links + sources/kinemathek.apply_ticket_links (2026-08-02).

cinemas.name: Stern Lichtspiele
cinemas._note: = CineStar Bonn (Markt 8), listed as 'CineStar Bonn' on kinoheld; keeps its webticketing3.cinestar.de deeplinks

cinemas.name: Open Air Bundeskunsthalle

ticket_note.de: Karten gibt es über die Seite des Kinos (cinetixx). Einlass 19.30 Uhr, Beginn 20.30 Uhr — bei schlechtem Wetter läuft der Film im Forum der Bundeskunsthalle.
ticket_note.en: Tickets are sold through the cinema's own page (cinetixx). Doors 7.30 pm, start 8.30 pm — in bad weather the film moves into the Forum of the Bundeskunsthalle.

cinemas._note: Open-air on the roof of the Bundeskunsthalle, run by the Bonner Kinemathek and published only on their programme page (sources/kinemathek.py) — kinoheld has the venue registered (id 1466) but carries no programme for it. Added 2026-08-01. No price entry: the Kinemathek's price list covers the Brotfabrik and the LandesMuseum, not the open-airs.

cinemas.name: Open Air Friesdorfer Freibad

ticket_note.de: Karten gibt es über die Seite des Kinos (cinetixx). Einlass ab 19 Uhr, Schwimmbadnutzung bis 21.10 Uhr, Beginn 21.30 Uhr.
ticket_note.en: Tickets are sold through the cinema's own page (cinetixx). Doors from 7 pm, the pool stays open until 9.10 pm, film starts 9.30 pm.

cinemas._note: The Kinemathek's other open-air, same source module and same reasoning as the Bundeskunsthalle roof.

cinemas.name: Stummfilmtage Bonn

ticket_note.de: Eintritt frei — es gibt keine Tickets. Einlass ab 19 Uhr in den Arkadenhof der Universität, Plätze der Reihe nach; um eine Spende wird gebeten.
ticket_note.en: Free admission — there are no tickets at all. Doors from 7 pm in the university's Arkadenhof, seats first come first served; donations welcome.

cinemas._note: The Internationale Stummfilmtage, 13.–22.8.2026 in the Arkadenhof — restored silent films with live music, and the one venue in either city where nothing is bookable because admission is free. Own Webflow site, scraped by sources/stummfilmtage.py. Runs ten nights a year and is simply absent the rest of the time.

cinemas.name: Arthaus-Kino im LandesMuseum
cinemas._note: Colmantstr. 14-16, 198 seats, in the Rheinisches LandesMuseum — the Bonner Kinemathek's second screen, so it shares their price list (kinoheld lists both bonnerkinemathek.de and lvr.de as its site). Roughly weekly, and kinoheld does carry its OV markers. Added 2026-08-01 by the coverage audit.

cinemas.name: Metropolis
cinemas._note: mostly-OV house. Not usably on kinoheld (id 974 there is an event venue) — scraped from their CineWeb site, tickets via kinotickets.express. Unmarked foreign-language films are corrected DE->OmU in main.py (fix_metropolis_ov)

cinemas.name: Filmpalette
cinemas._note: their https is broken (cert), http works. kinoheld drops their OmU/OmeU markers — corrected from their homepage text in main.py (apply_filmpalette_languages)

cinemas.name: Rex am Ring
cinemas._note: also kinoheld id 1088, but kinoheld drops nearly all their OmU/OV markers — their own CineWeb site is the truthful source (and has exact kinotickets.express links)

cinemas.name: Kölner Filmhaus
cinemas._note: filmhauskino.de, the address kinoheld still lists, expired — it served a hosting placeholder on 2026-07-30. Their live site is filmhaus-koeln.de ('Filmhaus Kino Köln', the name cinetixx sells under).

cinemas.name: Cineplex Köln
cinemas._note: cineplex.de answers 403 to every non-browser agent, so their prices can only be read by hand — the curated table in web/src/prices.js is all we have for them.

cinemas.name: Residenz Astor Film Lounge
cinemas._note: Kaiser-Wilhelm-Ring 30, 3 halls / 465 seats — the premium first-run house the coverage audit found missing (added 2026-08-01). Two caveats: kinoheld reports every one of its screenings as German, so its OV shows are under-labelled until we find a version source, and the cinema publishes NO price list at all (prices appear only inside the booking flow at koeln.premiumkino.de, which is not a CineOrder shop — the bundle carries no CENTER-OID). Hence no price_page and no entry in prices.js, same as the Woki.

cinemas.name: Filmforum NRW

ticket_note.de: Karten laufen über rausgegangen.de — die Seite des Kinos verlinkt die Tickets zur jeweiligen Reihe.
ticket_note.en: Tickets are sold through rausgegangen.de — the cinema's own page links the tickets for each series.

cinemas._note: Bischofsgartenstr. 1, in the Museum Ludwig, 257 seats. Repertory and themed series rather than a daily programme, so it is often empty for weeks. Like the Kinemathek it is a Cinepass cinema that kinoheld lists but cannot sell, and unlike the Kinemathek its own site has no per-screening ticket page to join on (tickets go through rausgegangen.de per series), so it is marked ticketing: info and links to its own programme. No standard price published, so no prices.js entry.

cinemas.name: SION Sommerkino
cinemas._note: Open-air at Harry-Blum-Platz, nightly in high summer and nothing the rest of the year. No published price list, so no prices.js entry.

cinemas.name: Cinedom
cinemas._note: Showtimes stay on kinoheld: audited against the shop 2026-07-30, kinoheld had all 313 of its screenings plus 24 more (today's, which the shop drops once the sale closes) and mis-filed none — the opposite of the Kinopolis case. But kinoheld carries almost none of their OV/OmU markers, and its deeplinks already point at Cinedom's own CineOrder shop (…?performance=<id>), so both the exact prices and the per-screening version are joined on from there (sources/cineorder.py): 48 screenings relabelled OV/OmU, 320 of 324 priced exactly. Their shop sells no 'Ermäßigt' category because Cinedom grants that fare only at the counter (Mo–Do before 17:00, on presentation of an ID).
